Hi, everybody! First, I'd like to say that I am extremely excited to have found out about voat, following recent events on another, less honorable website. I had been praying for something like this for a couple years by this point.

Everything has seemed fairly well structured, and the principled stance in favor of free speech is invaluable. But I don't exactly see this principle being honored. Why can't I downvote? Is it because I haven't garnered enough approval yet from the existing voat community? Is it because, as a new user, my opinions are not valued unless I'm jerking someone off? Voat tells me that their 100 points rule is in place to encourage participation... I don't really see how this is helpful, especially when this rule is a direct contradiction to the principled stance voat claims to hold, and which it has touted as its defining characteristic. It says "have your say", but apparently, freedom of speech on voat comes with terms and conditions. That sounds all too familiar to a former redditor such as myself.

Dissent and disapproval are CRUCIAL elements of free speech. I believe getting rid of downvotes, and sometimes hiding them, was a milestone in the degradation of certain reddit subs and the site as a whole. It was among the early steps towards censorship.

Do the admins of voat honestly believe that its new users, who are so careful and thoughtful about the content they browse, and who care enough about their involvement that they would change their allegiances from reddit to voat, are not willing to participate? That they need incentive to do so? I don't get it. And frankly, it worries me. All too often, things seem too good to be true. I sincerely hope that this isn't one of those instances.

How a company, group, website, what-have-you, behaves in regard to its own principles is very telling about how honestly and how highly those principles are held. To be lured into a community with the promise of free speech, only to be met with restrictions on how I may express my views and opinions, is disheartening and troubling. Have I been duped?

I believe in the cause that brought me here (to be clear, that cause is free speech, not hating fat people). I hope to death that voat flourishes. But this policy makes me doubt the people running this site. Perhaps it is an issue of dishonesty. Perhaps it is an issue of incompetence. Perhaps both. But to be so blatantly and unapologetically hypocritical is not the behavior of the honest AND competent.
